jobs.description: The University Hospital Bonn (UKB) is one of Germany’s leading university hospitals, combining top-level performance in medicine and research with excellence in teaching. Each year, more than half a million patients receive inpatient and outpatient care at the UKB. Around 3,500 students study medicine and dentistry here, and over 600 people are trained annually in healthcare professions. With approximately 9,900 employees, the UKB is the third-largest employer in the Bonn/Rhein-Sieg region. In the Focus hospital ranking, the UKB ranks first among university hospitals in North Rhine-Westphalia and second nationwide in terms of case mix index (case severity). In 2024, the UKB raised nearly €100 million in third-party funding for research, development, and teaching. The F.A.Z. Institute has named the UKB “Germany’s Training Champion” and “Germany’s Most Attractive Employer” for the fourth consecutive year.The following full-time (38.5 hours/week) position is to be filled as soon as possible at the Center of Neurology of the University Hospital Bonn:Postdoctoral Researcher in Computer Vision and Multimodal AI for the Early Detection of Parkinson’s Disease (m/w/d)The position is fixed-term until 30 September 2028 due to the duration of the research project.Parkinson’s disease is usually diagnosed only after substantial neurodegeneration has already occurred. Subtle changes in movement, facial expression and speech may emerge years earlier, but current clinical assessments are not designed to detect and quantify them at scale. We believe that computer vision and multimodal AI can help close this gap - and that meaningful progress requires researchers who want to apply cutting-edge methods to a major clinical challenge.Our goal is to develop objective and scalable digital tools for the early detection and monitoring of Parkinson’s disease. We combine video-based analysis of gait, balance, facial expression and limb movements with speech, touchscreen and wearable sensor data. A particular focus is on individuals with isolated REM sleep behavior disorder, who are at high risk of developing Parkinson’s disease or related neurodegenerative disorders.The group of Prof. Dr. Michael Sommerauer at the Center of Neurology at the University Hospital Bonn and the German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) is seeking a highly motivated postdoctoral researcher to join our interdisciplinary team.The successful candidate will take a leading role in the development of the computer vision components of bradyMX, our multimodal digital motor assessment platform. The position is embedded in the ERC-funded Re-START PD research program and offers the opportunity to work with unique, deeply phenotyped clinical cohorts and longitudinal datasets. Rather than developing methods in isolation, you will work closely with clinicians and neuroscientists to translate methodological advances into tools that may improve patient stratification, clinical trials and, ultimately, the way Parkinson’s disease is detected.Please submit your application as a single PDF, including: • a cover letter describing your scientific interests and motivation for joining the group • a curriculum vitae including a publication list • contact details for at least two refereesYour responsibilities:- Lead the development of computer vision methods for quantifying subtle motor abnormalities from clinical video recordings- Develop robust pipelines for human pose estimation, facial and body landmark detection, movement segmentation, tracking, feature extraction and automated quality control- Design and evaluate machine-learning and deep-learning models for the analysis of gait, balance, facial expression and upper- and lower-limb movements- Investigate temporal modelling, representation learning and interpretable movement features for the detection and monitoring of early motor dysfunction- Integrate video-derived features with complementary digital modalities such as speech, touchscreen tasks, inertial sensors and clinical assessments- Evaluate model robustness and generalizability across participants, recording conditions, devices and international study sites- Work closely with the clinical research team on study design, data collection, annotation strategies and the interpretation of model outputs- Prepare scientific manuscripts, present results at international conferences and contribute to grant applications- Support the supervision of doctoral, Master’s and medical studentsYour profile:- - A doctoral degree in computer vision, machine learning, computer science, biomedical engineering, medical informatics or a closely related discipline- Strong experience in machine learning and deep learning for image, video or human movement analysis- Excellent programming skills in Python and practical experience with frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow or JAX- Experience in one or more of the following areas: human pose estimation, motion tracking, action recognition, temporal modelling, self-supervised learning, multimodal learning or domain adaptation- A sound understanding of experimental design, quantitative model evaluation and reproducible research practices- Experience with version control and collaborative software development; knowledge of containerized workflows and high-performance computing is an advantage- Interest in translating methodological advances into clinically meaningful applications; previous experience in Parkinson’s disease or medical research is welcome but not required- A high degree of scientific curiosity, independence and commitment to rigorous research- Strong communication skills and enthusiasm for working in an interdisciplinary and international environment- Very good command of written and spoken English; German language skills are not requiredWhat we offer: - The opportunity to lead an innovative research project at the intersection of computer vision, application- Close collaboration with neurologists, neuroscientists, and international experts in Parkinson’s disease and digital biomarkers- An excellent research environment at the University Johannes Gutenberg University Mainz (JGU) is one of the largest universities in Germany. Thanks to its location in the Rhine-Main science region, the university can unfold to its full potential and showcase its innovative power and dynamism. Its status as a comprehensive university allows for multidisciplinary learning and teaching and has great potential for internationally renowned, interdisciplinary research. Almost all of its institutes are located on a single campus close to the Mainz city center - creating a lively academic culture for researchers, teaching staff, and students from every continent.Academic staff member (Postdoc): Plant RNA BiologyThe Wachter group investigates the molecular mechanisms and biological functions of alternative RNA splicing in plants (https://mps-imp.biologie.uni-mainz.de/). Our recent work has identified novel components of the plant splicing-regulatory code, including structured mRNA elements (e.g., https://doi.org/10.1111/tpj.71060 ) and position-dependent functions of pyrimidine motifs (https://doi.org/10.1111/tpj.16739). By combining these functional studies with global profiling approaches, we are building a framework to understand and engineer alternative splicing in the context of plant development and stress responses.As a member of our international research team, you will examine the regulation and functional impact of splicing decisions controlled by polypyrimidine tract-binding proteins (PTBs), a family of key splicing regulators in plants and animals. Your work will build on our previous findings on PTB functions in alternative splicing and on recent results from ongoing transcriptome-wide approaches, including splicing pattern profiling, iCLIP, and TRIBE. You will further develop these analysis pipelines and integrate the resulting datasets to define the role of this central component of splicing control in the model plant Arabidopsis thaliana. The new insights from these mechanistic studies will be linked to physiological PTB functions we previously observed, including ABA-dependent seed germination and drought tolerance. The overarching goal of this project is to establish the molecular connections between PTB functions and key traits of stress physiology, thereby laying the groundwork for novel strategies to enhance plant resilience. About AtariAtari is an interactive entertainment company and an iconic gaming industry brand recognized worldwide for its multi-platform games and licensed products. Atari owns and/or manages a portfolio of more than 400 games and franchises, including globally recognized brands such as Asteroids®, Centipede®, Missile Command®, Pong®, and RollerCoaster Tycoon®.The Atari family of brands includes Digital Eclipse, Nightdive Studios, Infogrames, AtariAge, MobyGames, as well as Hipster Whale, Coatsink, Early Morning Studios, and Stormteller Games—spanning game development, publishing, and community experiences worldwide.Atari operates internationally with offices in the US, UK, in France, Germany, Sweden, and India.About the roleMünster, Germany · Part-timeThe Executive Assistant & Project Coordinator will provide executive, administrative and project coordination support to the CFO. Based in Germany and working closely with the CFO in France, you will help keep financial administration, corporate governance and cross-border operational matters moving to completion.This is a practical coordination role for someone who is organised, persistent and comfortable following up with banks, lawyers, tax advisers, notaries, corporate service providers and internal teams. You will coordinate documents, signatures, banking administration, KYC and AML requests, legal entity changes and board formalities across the Atari Group.You do not need to be an accountant or a technical finance specialist. You do need to be reliable with sensitive information, comfortable with formal processes and willing to chase the right people until an item is complete.What you’ll do- Provide day-to-day executive and administrative support to the CFO, coordinating priorities across Germany, France and the US.- Coordinate the preparation, circulation, approval and execution of corporate documents, board resolutions, powers of attorney and other legal or finance documentation.- Manage signature workflows, monitor outstanding actions and ensure documents are signed, returned and stored on time.- Coordinate banking administration, including account openings and closures, bank mandates, signatory updates and KYC/AML requests.- Maintain accurate corporate records and legal entity documentation, ensuring information is complete, current and easy to retrieve.- Support legal entity shutdowns, entity administration and related projects by coordinating actions across Finance, Legal, tax advisers, banks and external service providers.- Liaise with banks, external legal counsel, tax lawyers, corporate service providers, notaries and local finance teams on administrative and corporate matters.- Coordinate board minutes, governance records, approvals, formalities and other recurring corporate requirements.- Support finance-related administrative work, including gathering information, tracking deadlines, maintaining records and coordinating deliverables.- Act as a project coordinator for cross-functional finance and governance workstreams, keeping owners aligned and following through on open items.- Provide administrative support for certain Luxembourg-related matters and coordinate with the relevant internal and external contacts.- Escalate delays, missing information, unclear ownership or material issues to the CFO or relevant functional lead.Requirements & Qualifications- Professional fluency in English, with the ability to communicate clearly in writing and verbally with internal and external stakeholders.- Experience in an administrative, executive support, banking, legal operations, paralegal, corporate services or similar coordination role.- Strong organisation and follow-through, with the confidence to chase people, manage deadlines and keep multiple workstreams moving.- Experience handling confidential information and formal documentation with accuracy and discretion.- Comfort working with banks, lawyers, advisers, notaries, corporate service providers or other external stakeholders.- Ability to work independently, prioritise changing requests and operate with flexibility when the CFO and key stakeholders are based in another country.- Good judgement and attention to detail when coordinating governance, KYC/AML, banking and legal entity administration.Nice to have- Professional proficiency in French.- Experience supporting a CFO, finance leader, executive team or European corporate function.- Experience in a bank, financial institution, law office, corporate services provider or multinational business.- Familiarity with KYC/AML processes, bank mandates, signatory administration, powers of attorney, board documentation or legal entity management.- Experience coordinating entity closures, corporate reorganisations, acquisitions or other cross-border projects.- Familiarity with Luxembourg corporate or finance administration.How you’ll workThis role is about making sure important administrative and governance work does not sit unresolved. You will often be coordinating several parties at once, clarifying what is needed, tracking who owns the next step and following up until the document, approval, bank request or entity action is complete.You will work closely with Finance and Legal, but you are not expected to provide accounting or legal advice. Your value will come from being dependable, organised and persistent, and from creating enough structure that the CFO and specialist advisers can make decisions and complete formalities efficiently.The role requires flexibility in working hours to accommodate cross-border coordination with the CFO in France, banks, advisers and teams in other time zones.Why join AtariThis role sits at the centre of an international finance and governance environment. You will work across Germany, France, Luxembourg and other Atari Group locations, helping coordinate the formalities and projects that support the Group’s entities and operations.You will have visibility across Finance, Legal and senior leadership, with the opportunity to build a reliable operating rhythm for corporate administration and cross-border coordination as Atari continues to integrate and develop its international business.EEO StatementAtari is an equal opportunity employer and we are committed to providing a workplace free from harassment and discrimination. jobs.description: OUR COMPANYAt Boehringer Ingelheim we develop breakthrough therapies and innovative healthcare solutions in areas of unmet medical need for both humans and animals. As a family owned company, we focus on long-term performance. We believe that, if we have talented and ambitious people who are passionate about innovation, there is no limit to what we can achieve; after all, we started with just 28 people. Now, we are powered by 50,000 employees globally who nurture a diverse, collaborative and inclusive culture.The PositionAre you passionate about cardiovascular science and dedicated to ensuring patient health and safety? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you!Our CRM team is seeking an experienced Lead Patient Safety Physician with expertise in cardiovascular, renal, and/or metabolic diseases. In this pivotal role, you will contribute to one of Boehringer Ingelheim's priority assets in late-stage clinical development, making a meaningful impact on patient safety worldwide.This position can be filled in Ingelheim or Biberach.Tasks & responsibilities- Lead, manage, and provide medical-scientific direction to a team of Patient Safety Physicians responsible for a compound/asset, including project management, project-specific guidance, team coaching, and review of team output- Play a key role in global regulatory submissions across all regions- Develop proactive patient-centric risk minimization strategies for assigned assets on a global scale- Enhance the value of BI assets through robust assessment of the benefit-risk profile- Design evidence strategies that differentiate the asset through its benefit-risk profile, considering the scientific knowledge for the molecule, medical safety landscape, population, regulatory landscape, and patient perspective- Generate safety evidence and perform safety & efficacy analyses to support decision-making by patients, regulators, HCPs, payors, and HTA bodies- Ensure patient safety while adhering to the highest quality and ethical standardsRequirements- Medical Doctor with strong clinical and/or clinical research experience- Profound experience in patient safety at a pharmaceutical company on a global/corporate level, including clinical development and post-marketing safety- Comprehensive understanding of pharmacovigilance regulations in major markets and the need for compliance- Broad knowledge of the pharmaceutical industry, and interest in future trends and developments in pharmacovigilance- Clinical or research experience in the cardio-renal-metabolic field- Proven leadership, people management & project management skills- Excellent collaboration, communication, and negotiation skills- Strong ethical sense with a quality and patient centricity mindset- Fluent in English, both written and spokenAs part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package.Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.Want to learn more?
